tiebreaker_total_a2_expected_share_posth.description: POST-HOC, NOT PREDECLARED. Tiebreaker total arm A2 vs A0 on a variance-reduced estimator of the same estimand: expected tiebreak share integrated over the 2009-2019 empirical distribution of actual-minus-market total, instead of counting realized hits. Same declared 284-rival field. UNITS PLACEHOLDER: the effect is a closest-share PROBABILITY difference, not a correlation. EFFECT_UNITS has no probability unit and labelling a 0.35%-scale tiebreak-win share accuracy_points would put a non-commensurable quantity into the NFL ATS pool. Never pool this row with anything but its own family. Predeclared in docs/tiebreaker_total.md; 107 last-games-of-week 2020-2025; paired week-blocked bootstrap 20000 draws seed 20260821; baseline is A0, the tiebreaker chain served today (joint-residual total blended at 0.1, then the pick-side-consistent score lattice).
tiebreaker_total_a2_expected_share_posth.notes: Estimator chosen AFTER seeing that the predeclared one was a 3-count statistic. Not a confirmatory look. The effect is entirely a property of the declared rival field; no real rival tiebreaker guesses have ever been captured.
tiebreaker_total_a2_expected_share_posth.plain_summary: Snapping the betting total to a combined score football actually produces should win the weekly tiebreaker about 5% more often than the guess we publish.
